Check that each realized selected D/A pair lies in the owner-count feasible domain. Reject a missing state; never add an outcome-selected exception.

For every candidate map each triple to the sorted multiset of its three transformed pair keys. Enumerate sorted feature catalogs, XOR dependency rows and lexicographically ordered row bases using structure only.

Independently verify row reconstruction, basis ranks, scalar consistency and any contradiction certificates; use a different GF(2) representation in the verifier.
